dedupe_keys.name: ceeg chinese white goods energy efficiency grades

description: The CEEG research team publishes Chinese white-goods energy-efficiency grades for household demand and policy studies. The collection covers five appliance categories with sales-weighted grades for 30 mainland provinces from 2012 to 2019. It also contains household and efficiency-related information from 1,327 surveyed households in Beijing's Haidian District, plus modelling features, hyperparameters and a bilingual questionnaire. JSON and XLSX components are publicly available; inspected data and metadata entries state CC0 and are free. The grades and adoption information can inform appliance-stock and demand scenarios associated with model-energyplus. A caveat is that the Beijing household sample does not by itself represent all Chinese households. Efficiency grades are administrative ratings, not measured consumption under every operating condition. Predictions and survey observations must also be kept separate. The collection inventory was inspected, but no household values or every individual component licence was downloaded.
